title: Count characters in a fixed short sentence
rationale: Character accounting underlies fixed-width formats and validation rules; an unstable count breaks parsers that assume model output is exactly calibrated.

prompt.content: You are a precise counting assistant. Answer with the number only, with no other text.
Count the characters in the following sentence, counting every character inside the quotation marks including spaces and the final period: "A calm river bends slowly." Answer with the number only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one integer answer. Expected value 26, computed in Python: A calm river bends slowly. is 21 letters + 4 spaces + 1 final period = 26 characters. Brittleness: a counter that excludes spaces (22) or the final period (25) fails; the prompt states the counting convention explicitly so the pass condition stays unambiguous.
